## About
Uncle Johns Auto Repair is a local auto repair and tire shop on Woodward Ave in Royal Oak. We work on cars, trucks and SUVs for folks in Royal Oak, Clawson, Berkley and the surrounding areas.
John, the owner, is hands on. Customers tell us they like that we speak the truth, explain our concerns and don't push. One reviewer put it simply: they treat you like family at Uncle John's. That's how we want it.
There's free coffee while you wait, or ask about our local shuttle service and loaner cars. We're rated 4.8 from 121 Google reviews, and we'd like to earn yours too.

## Services
- Brake Repair: Worried about your brakes? Bring the car in and we'll diagnose it and tell you what brake service you actually need.
- Steering & Suspension: Steering and suspension work for Royal Oak, Clawson, Berkley and nearby, to keep your car driving right.
- Engine Diagnostics and Performance: Check engine light won't go off? We'll find out why and pinpoint the cause behind other engine performance issues.
- Climate Control: Maintenance and repair of your car's climate control system so it keeps working the way it should.
- Preventive Maintenance: Staying on the schedule in your owner's manual is the best way to avoid surprise repairs. We'll help you keep up with it.
- Car, Truck & SUV Tires: Shop for tires for your car, truck or SUV, and have them put on right here at the shop.
- Exhaust System Repair: Mufflers and exhaust work. When a job calls for parts from an OEM dealer, we'll get them.
- Axle, CV Joint & Driveshaft Repair: Axle, CV joint and driveshaft repair, explained clearly before we start.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How does scheduling online work?
A: Send us a service request with the time you'd like. That doesn't lock in the slot, but we'll be in touch within 24 hours to set a time that works for you.

Q: Do you have loaner cars?
A: Yes, loaner cars are available. Give us a call to ask about one when you book.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We're in Royal Oak and work on cars from Clawson, Berkley and the surrounding areas too.
